comparisons.peer_summary: The firm provides ongoing educational offerings, orientation programs for new hires emphasizing culture, and annual training events to instill its culture and accelerate integration, with senior employees receiving specific leadership guidance.
comparisons.comparison: Both Bank of America and Goldman Sachs emphasize training as a core component of employee development and culture integration. BAC reports 7.6 million hours of training via its Academy and internal mobility for over 12,000 employees, focusing on skill-building and leadership. Similarly, Goldman Sachs highlights training's role in instilling culture, offering ongoing educational offerings and orientation programs for new hires, with nearly all employees participating in at least one training event annually, and specific leadership guidance for senior employees.

sentences.text: We provide a variety of resources to help employees grow in their current roles and build new skills, including resources to help employees find new opportunities, re-skill and seek leadership positions.

In 2024, more than 12,000 employees found new roles within the Corporation, and we delivered approximately 7.6 million hours of training and development to our teammates through Bank of America Academy.
Instilling our culture in all employees is a continuous process, in which training plays an important part.

To accelerate their integration into the firm and our culture, new hires have the opportunity to receive training as soon as they start working via orientation programs that emphasize culture and networking, and nearly all employees participate in at least one training event each year.
For our more senior employees, we provide guidance and training on how to manage people and projects effectively, exhibit strong leadership and exemplify our culture.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm offers extensive voluntary training programs and educational resources covering leadership, artificial intelligence, data literacy, and professional skills.

JPMorgan Chase also offers extensive voluntary training programs covering leadership, artificial intelligence, data literacy, and professional skills for all employees.

sentences.text: We provide a variety of resources to help employees grow in their current roles and build new skills, including resources to help employees find new opportunities, re-skill and seek leadership positions.

We have 11 Employee Networks with over 320,000 voluntary memberships, which provide teammates opportunities to meet new people, have an impact across multiple business lines and grow personally and professionally.
We are committed to the development of our workforce and supporting mobility and career growth.
Our talent development programs are designed to provide employees with the resources to help them achieve their career goals, build management skills and lead their organizations.
We continue to offer leadership programs to support employees as they progress in their career at the Firm.
